phase_prompt.summary: The Sons of the Holy Angels traversing the plasma fields of the upper simulation layer, observed by the Voyager.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic full shot. Figures in pristine white, structured robes walking on a surface of flowing, molten fire. The fire emits a strong orange glow that uplights the figures. Their faces are pale, textured like compacted hail or translucent white stone, reflecting the firelight. The environment is the upper edge of a simulation dome, transitioning into deep space. High dynamic range, sharp focus, atmospheric distortion from the heat.
